description: VirtualizedList is the base implementation behind FlatList and SectionList. It provides high performance rendering for very large lists by rendering only visible items and replacing offscreen items with blank space.
whenToUse: When you need more control than FlatList or SectionList
When working with immutable or non-array data
When building highly optimized large lists

coreConcept.virtualization: Only a small window of items is rendered at a time to improve memory usage and performance
coreConcept.renderWindow: Visible items plus a buffer area above and below the screen

data.description: Data source passed to getItem and getItemCount

getItem.description: Returns an item from the data for a given index

getItemCount.description: Returns the total number of items in the data

renderItem.description: Renders an item into the list

importantProps.name: keyExtractor
importantProps.description: Extracts a unique key for each item

importantProps.name: windowSize
importantProps.description: Number of screens rendered outside visible area

importantProps.name: extraData
importantProps.description: Triggers re-render when external data changes

scrollEvents.name: onEndReached
scrollEvents.description: Called when user scrolls near the end

scrollEvents.name: onStartReached
scrollEvents.description: Called when user scrolls near the start

caveats: Internal state is lost when items unmount
Fast scrolling may show blank areas briefly

comparison.FlatList: Easier to use, built on top of VirtualizedList
comparison.SectionList: Adds section support on top of VirtualizedList
